title: editcap: use wtap_rec *rec only where it doesn't just point to read_rec.
description:
Instad, just directly refer to read_rec.

That makes it clearer which code might modify wtap_rec components before
writing the packet out.

Fix a comment to indicate that we might do more than just truncating a
packet, such as modifying its time stamp.
